title: AI is a co-pilot, not autopilot

slides.title: AI is a co-pilot, not autopilot.
slides.body: Use it to move faster. Keep your judgment in the driver's seat.

slides.title: Give AI a clear job.
slides.body: State your goal, audience, context and the format you need. Specific inputs make useful drafts.

slides.title: Treat the first answer as a draft.
slides.body: Ask for alternatives, missing angles and a simpler version before you choose a direction.

slides.title: Check every claim that matters.
slides.body: Open the source. Confirm dates, numbers and quotes before sharing them.

slides.title: Add your lived experience.
slides.body: Your examples, taste and point of view turn generic output into something worth sharing.

slides.title: Try one small workflow this week.
slides.body: Pick a repetitive task. Draft with AI, review carefully, and keep what genuinely helps.
